tests.title: Add worksheet to a workbook containing only Sheet1 creates Sheet2, makes it active with A1 selected, leaves Sheet1 unchanged, and persists after refresh
checks: Button 'Add worksheet' is visible and clickable in tab bar
New tab with accessible name Sheet2 appears
Sheet2 tab has aria-selected=true and its grid is active with A1 selected
Sheet2 grid is blank and does not inherit filters/validation/pivot from Sheet1
Sheet1 tab and its data remain unchanged
After refresh/reopen, Sheet2 still exists and is active

tests.title: Add worksheet when Sheet1 and Sheet2 already exist assigns the first unused SheetN name (Sheet3), keeps existing sheets unchanged, and persists
checks: New tab is named Sheet3 (first unused SheetN in positive-integer order)
New worksheet is blank and does not inherit filters, validation, or pivot results
New worksheet becomes active and A1 is selected
Existing Sheet1 and Sheet2 remain unchanged
After refresh, Sheet3 still exists

tests.title: Click another worksheet tab and all worksheet state (grid, row/column structure, selection, formula bar, filters, validation, pivot results) switches to that tab; active tab persists after refresh
checks: Target tab has aria-selected=true
Grid displays target worksheet values (East/1200, North/800)
Selected cell, formula bar, filter buttons, validation entry points, and pivot results match target worksheet
After refresh, the same tab remains active with the same state

tests.title: After switching to a worksheet, the Formula bar displays the selected cell's ordinary value or original formula while the grid shows the value/result
checks: Formula bar labeled 'Formula bar' is present
For ordinary cell, formula bar equals grid value
For formula cell, formula bar shows original formula and grid shows calculated result

tests.title: Switch to a worksheet with no selection history selects A1 as the current cell
checks: A1 gridcell has aria-selected=true
Current cell indicator is A1
Formula bar reflects A1's value or empty state

tests.title: Switching away from and back to a worksheet does not modify it; its most recent successful state is restored on return
checks: Source worksheet grid values unchanged after returning
Saved selection on source worksheet restored
No data from the other worksheet appears in source grid
Formula bar shows source worksheet's selected cell content

tests.title: Reopening/refreshing the workbook directly displays the last active tab and restores each worksheet's last confirmed selected cell
checks: Active tab after refresh is the last active tab before refresh
Switching to another worksheet shows its last confirmed selected cell
aria-selected states inside/outside the saved selection match the saved rectangle
Grid values and formulas per worksheet are restored

tests.title: Rename a worksheet via its tab menu to a new unique name; the tab shows the new name and it persists after refresh
checks: Worksheet options button for target tab opens menu with menuitem 'Rename'
Dialog 'Rename worksheet' opens with textbox 'Worksheet name' prefilled with current name
Enter new name and click Save
Tab accessible name becomes the new name
After refresh/reopen, tab still shows new name

tests.title: Attempt to rename a worksheet to an empty or whitespace-only name is rejected with 'Worksheet name cannot be empty'; original name remains and persists
checks: Enter spaces or empty text in 'Worksheet name'
Error 'Worksheet name cannot be empty' displayed
Tab still shows original worksheet name
After refresh, original name remains

tests.title: Attempt to rename a worksheet to a duplicate name is rejected with 'Worksheet name already exists'; original name remains and persists
checks: Enter an existing worksheet name (e.g., Sheet2)
Error 'Worksheet name already exists' displayed
Tab still shows original worksheet name
After refresh, original name remains

tests.title: Delete a worksheet through its tab menu and confirm in the Delete worksheet dialog; target tab/data disappear, an adjacent tab becomes active, and deletion persists after refresh
checks: Menu 'Delete' command opens dialog 'Delete worksheet' whose text includes target worksheet name
Click 'Delete worksheet' confirmation button
Target tab no longer present and adjacent worksheet tab is active
Target data/formulas/filters/validation/pivot no longer appear
After refresh, target tab remains absent

tests.title: Delete a pivot-result worksheet: target pivot tab disappears and its source worksheet is no longer constrained by that pivot table; source data unchanged
checks: Delete command opens confirmation dialog for pivot-result worksheet
After confirm, pivot-result tab is absent
Attempting to delete source worksheet no longer shows 'Please delete or rebuild dependent pivot tables first'
Source worksheet data remains unchanged

tests.title: Attempt to delete a worksheet that is still a pivot-table source is rejected with 'Please delete or rebuild dependent pivot tables first'; dialog closes and both source data and pivot results remain unchanged
checks: Confirmation for source worksheet is attempted
Error 'Please delete or rebuild dependent pivot tables first' displayed
Source worksheet tab/grid remains visible unchanged
Pivot results remain unchanged
After refresh, both still present

tests.title: Delete the only remaining worksheet: no confirmation dialog opens, 'A workbook must contain at least one worksheet' is displayed, and the worksheet remains after refresh
checks: Clicking Delete on last worksheet does not open 'Delete worksheet' dialog
Error 'A workbook must contain at least one worksheet' displayed
Worksheet tab remains present
After refresh, worksheet still present

tests.title: Insert 1 row above row 3 via the row-number menu: row 3 and subsequent rows shift down, formulas/validation/filters follow, and structure persists after refresh
checks: Row-number menu for row 3 provides 'Insert 1 row above' menuitem
New blank row appears at row 3 and old row 3 moves to row 4
Subsequent complete records, validation rules, and formula references shift downward together
Formula bar displays adjusted original formulas and correct results
Row headers use ARIA rowheader with decimal row numbers
After refresh, inserted blank row remains

tests.title: Insert 1 row below row 3: subsequent rows shift down, new blank row appears below target, formulas adjust, and the structure persists after refresh
checks: Row-number menu provides 'Insert 1 row below'
New blank row appears below row 3 and old row 4 moves down
Validation rules and formula references shift down together
After refresh, structure persists

tests.title: Delete row 3 via row-number menu: subsequent rows shift up, target row's validation rules are removed, affected formulas adjust or show explicit error, and the deletion persists
checks: Row-number menu for row 3 provides 'Delete row'
Row 3 removed and old row 4 moves up to row 3
Rules on deleted row are removed; cells outside deleted row preserved
Affected formulas display adjusted formulas/results; unpreservable references show explicit error
After refresh, deletion persists

tests.title: After a row structure change shifts a 0-to-100 numeric validation rule onto an out-of-range value, entering that value is rejected with 'Please enter a number from 0 to 100' and the original value remains
checks: Cell subject to shifted 0-to-100 rule exists
Attempt to enter 101 through grid or formula bar displays 'Please enter a number from 0 to 100'
Operation rejected and original value remains
No partial record created

tests.title: A row change overlapping a pivot-table source range leaves existing pivot results unchanged until 'Refresh pivot table' is clicked, after which results are recomputed from the adjusted range and persist
checks: Before refresh, pivot result shows old source range/values
Click 'Refresh pivot table' on pivot result worksheet
Pivot result recomputed using adjusted row range
Source worksheet data unchanged
After refresh, recomputed pivot results persist

tests.title: Insert 1 column left of column B via the column-header menu: column B and subsequent columns shift right, formulas/validation/filters adjust, and the structure persists after refresh
checks: Column-header menu for B provides 'Insert 1 column left'
New blank column appears at B and old B moves to C
Complete data, validation rules, and formula references in B+ shift right together
Column headers use ARIA columnheader with column letters
After refresh, inserted column remains

tests.title: Insert 1 column right of column B: subsequent columns shift right, new blank column appears to the right of B, formulas adjust, and the structure persists
checks: Column-header menu provides 'Insert 1 column right'
New blank column appears after B and old C moves to D
Data/formulas/validation outside inserted column remain shifted correctly
After refresh, structure persists

tests.title: Delete column B via column-header menu: subsequent columns shift left, data outside B preserved, direct references to B display #REF!, and the deletion persists
checks: Column-header menu provides 'Delete column'
Column B removed and old C moves to B
Rules on deleted column are removed
Direct formulas referencing B display #REF! in grid and formula bar; other formulas adjust
After refresh, deletion persists

tests.title: After a column structure change shifts a 0-to-100 numeric validation rule onto an out-of-range value, entering 101 displays 'Please enter a number from 0 to 100' and the edit is rejected; original value remains
checks: Shifted 0-to-100 rule present on target cell
Enter 101 displays 'Please enter a number from 0 to 100'
Original value retained and no partial change occurs

tests.title: After pivot-table source columns move, existing pivot results remain unchanged until 'Refresh pivot table' is clicked, then recompute using moved fields; a deleted selected header causes 'Pivot field is no longer available. Select a new field.' and preserves last successful result
checks: Before refresh, pivot result uses old columns/values
Click 'Refresh pivot table' after column move: pivot recomputes with moved fields
If selected header deleted, refresh displays 'Pivot field is no longer available. Select a new field.'
Last successful pivot result preserved and source worksheet not modified
